title.zh: 电池为什么就是装不下更多电
title.en: Why Batteries Just Can't Hold More Charge

desc.zh: 从半反应、法拉第常数和能斯特方程出发，一路算到电芯的能量密度、快充、热失控、衰老和成本，最后看 2026 年的前沿：每一步都有可以推动的模型。
desc.en: Starting from half-reactions, the Faraday constant and the Nernst equation, we work all the way through a cell's energy density, fast charging, thermal runaway, aging and cost, and end with the 2026 frontier: every step has a model you can push around.
